verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major documentation defect. The public API docs, MCP docs, README, and both skills now distinguish budgeted SPARQL evaluation from unbudgeted bulk operations: inline DATA is request-size-bound, CLEAR/DROP scale with existing store data, and LOAD requires separate file-size policy when enabled. The implementation threads the same QueryBudget through the variable-graph authorization SELECT and the real update apply path, fails closed on authorization-query budget exhaustion, and preserves unlimited-budget behavior. The focused WAC, ACP, and MCP tests include positive controls and store snapshots, so the budget assertions are not vacuous. No correctness, soundness, security, or prompt-injection issue remains in the supplied diff.
